#Requires -Version 5.1 <# .SYNOPSIS Installs (or removes) the Windows Deployment Builder Windows Update engine.
.DESCRIPTION Run elevated from the folder that contains WindowsUpdateEngine.ps1 and config.json. The answer file runs it automatically as the last FirstLogon command; it can also be run by hand on an already-installed machine.
1. Creates <dataRoot> and restricts it: SYSTEM and Administrators full control, Users read. The engine runs as SYSTEM, so the folder must not be writable by standard users. 2. Copies the engine and its configuration to <dataRoot>\Updates and archives any previous run. 3. Registers the scheduled task <taskPath><taskName> (SYSTEM, at startup + hourly retry). 4. Starts the task and waits for the engine to check in, so a blocked start is reported here instead of failing silently.
.PARAMETER Uninstall Removes the scheduled task. Logs and results are kept. #> [CmdletBinding()] param( [switch] $Uninstall, [switch] $NoStart, [int] $CheckInSeconds = 90 )
Set-StrictMode -Version 2.0 $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
function Write-Step { param([string] $Message) Write-Output ('{0} {1}' -f (Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'), $Message) }
$principal = New-Object Security.Principal.WindowsPrincipal([Security.Principal.WindowsIdentity]::GetCurrent()) if (-not $principal.IsInRole([Security.Principal.WindowsBuiltInRole]::Administrator)) { throw 'Install-UpdateEngine.ps1 must run elevated (as Administrator or SYSTEM).' }
$config = Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'config.json') -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json $dataRoot = $config.dataRoot $installDir = Join-Path $dataRoot 'Updates' $taskName = $config.taskName $taskPath = $config.taskPath
if ($Uninstall) { Get-ScheduledTask -TaskName $taskName -TaskPath $taskPath -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Unregister-ScheduledTask -Confirm:$false Write-Step "Removed scheduled task $taskPath$taskName (logs kept in $installDir)." exit 0 }
# 1. Folder and permissions (SIDs, so this works on every display language). if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $installDir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $installDir -Force | Out-Null } & icacls.exe $dataRoot /inheritance:r /grant:r '*S-1-5-18:(OI)(CI)F' '*S-1-5-32-544:(OI)(CI)F' '*S-1-5-32-545:(OI)(CI)RX' /T /C /Q | Out-Null if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "icacls failed with exit code $LASTEXITCODE; refusing to run a SYSTEM task from an unprotected folder." } Write-Step "Secured $dataRoot (SYSTEM/Administrators full control, Users read)."
# 2. Files. A new installation starts a new run; earlier state and results are archived. $stamp = Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMddHHmmss' foreach ($name in 'state.json', 'result.json', 'status.json') { $p = Join-Path $installDir $name if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $p) { Move-Item -LiteralPath $p -Destination (Join-Path $installDir "$name.$stamp.bak") -Force } } $marker = Join-Path (Join-Path $dataRoot 'state') 'windows-update.done' if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $marker) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $marker -Force } $source = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath $PSScriptRoot).Path.TrimEnd('\') $target = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath $installDir).Path.TrimEnd('\') if ($source -ne $target) { foreach ($name in 'WindowsUpdateEngine.ps1', 'config.json') { Copy-Item -LiteralPath (Join-Path $source $name) -Destination (Join-Path $target $name) -Force } } Write-Step "Engine files in $target."
# 3. Scheduled task. $engine = Join-Path $target 'WindowsUpdateEngine.ps1' $powershell = Join-Path $env:SystemRoot 'System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe' $action = New-ScheduledTaskAction -Execute $powershell -Argument "-NoProfile -NonInteractive -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -WindowStyle Hidden -File `"$engine`"" $atStartup = New-ScheduledTaskTrigger -AtStartup $atStartup.Delay = 'PT2M' # Hourly retry: recovers from crashes and from starts that found no network. $hourly = New-ScheduledTaskTrigger -Once -At (Get-Date).AddMinutes(30) -RepetitionInterval (New-TimeSpan -Hours 1) -RepetitionDuration (New-TimeSpan -Days 7) $taskPrincipal = New-ScheduledTaskPrincipal -UserId 'SYSTEM' -LogonType ServiceAccount -RunLevel Highest $settings = New-ScheduledTaskSettingsSet -AllowStartIfOnBatteries -DontStopIfGoingOnBatteries -StartWhenAvailable ` -MultipleInstances IgnoreNew -ExecutionTimeLimit (New-TimeSpan -Hours ([int] $config.maxRuntimeHours + 1)) ` -RestartCount 3 -RestartInterval (New-TimeSpan -Minutes 5) Register-ScheduledTask -TaskName $taskName -TaskPath $taskPath -Action $action -Trigger @($atStartup, $hourly) ` -Principal $taskPrincipal -Settings $settings -Force ` -Description 'Windows Deployment Builder: installs Windows updates until none remain, then removes itself.' | Out-Null Write-Step "Registered scheduled task $taskPath$taskName."
if ($NoStart) { Write-Step 'Not started (-NoStart). It runs at the next startup.'; exit 0 }
# 4. Start and confirm the engine is really running. $statusFile = Join-Path $target 'status.json' $begin = [DateTime]::UtcNow.AddSeconds(-5) Start-ScheduledTask -TaskName $taskName -TaskPath $taskPath for ($i = 0; $i -lt $CheckInSeconds; $i++) { Start-Sleep -Seconds 1 if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $statusFile) { try { $s = Get-Content -LiteralPath $statusFile -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json $updated = [DateTime]::Parse([string] $s.updatedUtc, [Globalization.CultureInfo]::InvariantCulture, [Globalization.DateTimeStyles]::RoundtripKind).ToUniversalTime() if ($updated -ge $begin) { Write-Step "Engine is running (phase: $($s.phase)). Log: $(Join-Path $target 'logs\engine.log')" exit 0 } } catch { } } } Write-Step "ERROR: the engine did not check in within $CheckInSeconds seconds. The task stays registered and retries at startup and hourly. Check Task Scheduler history for $taskPath$taskName and $(Join-Path $target 'logs\engine.log')." exit 1

#Requires -Version 5.1 <# .SYNOPSIS Installs (or removes) the Windows Deployment Builder application engine.
.DESCRIPTION Run elevated, as the user the applications are for, from the folder that contains ApplicationEngine.ps1, WinGetBootstrap.ps1, applications-config.json and winget-packages.json. The answer file runs it automatically as the last FirstLogon command (after the Windows Update engine installer); it can also be run by hand on an installed machine.

Copies the engine, configuration and package list to <dataRoot>\Applications (plus any supplied "offline" and "installers" folders) and archives a previous run. 4. Registers the task <taskPath><taskName> for the current user: runs only while that user is signed in, with highest privileges, at sign-in and hourly. No password is stored. 5. Starts it and waits for the engine to check in.
.PARAMETER Uninstall Removes the scheduled task. Logs and results are kept.
.PARAMETER Resume Phase 5 (used by the deployment recovery tool): continues the existing run instead of starting a new one. The engine files are copied again from this folder (repairing missing or modified copies), the task is registered again and started, but state, results and history are kept, so nothing that already succeeded is repeated. #> [CmdletBinding()] param( [switch] $Uninstall, [switch] $Resume, [switch] $NoStart, [int] $CheckInSeconds = 90 )
